name: vehicle-scheduling-ip
description: Vehicle scheduling problem (VSP) as a minimum-cost flow / assignment IP on a trip-connection graph. Each trip node must be entered and left exactly once via selected connections (including deadhead/depot connections); minimizes total connection cost. Equivalent to an integer min-cost circulation covering all trips.

indices.name: N
indices.description: set of trip nodes of the trip graph (each non-depot node is one scheduled trip); depot nodes are excluded from the degree constraints

indices.name: A
indices.description: set of trip connections (edges of the trip graph), including deadhead and depot connections

indices.name: delta__n
indices.description: incoming connections of trip node n

parameters.name: c
parameters.description: cost of using trip connection a (objective coefficient) [domain R_>=0]

variables.name: v
variables.description: 1 if trip connection a is used in the vehicle schedule, 0 otherwise

constraints.name: incoming_degree
constraints.description: each (non-depot) trip is served by exactly one incoming connection [capture: sum over a widened to family A; source binder: 'a \\in \\mathit{delta}^-(n)']

constraints.name: outgoing_degree
constraints.description: each (non-depot) trip is left by exactly one outgoing connection [capture: sum over a widened to family A; source binder: 'a \\in \\mathit{delta}^+(n)']

objective.name: objective
objective.description: minimize total cost of the selected trip connections
